description:
What is This Part?
These connect the carpet to the floor pan.
These will mate to the Clips that are already installed in your Samurai.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 10 – Carpet Clips/Snaps
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
